description:
Reassignment local search only:
- Broken Edge Repair: For each broken adjacent edge, evaluate releasing lower-reward endpoint vs. releasing higher-reward endpoint 
(tie-break: previous vs. next endpoint).
- Reconsider: Reconsider incoming unscheduled tasks followed by released endpoint.
- Acceptance: Return feasible issued trial with higher profit; return null if no broken edges or no feasible trial.
